outcome: Intra-operative complications (e.g., blood transfusion, extension of uterine angle incision, adhesion, scar dehiscence, placenta previa)
Post-operative complications (e.g., prolonged hospitalization, fever, delayed return of bowel movements, prolonged catheterization)
cohort: A total of 100 women who underwent caesarean section at Assam Medical College and experienced complications during or after the surgery were included.
finding: Repeat caesarean section is associated with a higher incidence and severity of both intra-operative and post-operative complications compared to primary caesarean section, and complications increase with the rising number of repeat procedures.
